name: Central Appalachia Habitat Stewardship Program
summary: Grants to restore forests, grasslands, rivers and streams across central Appalachia, such as managing forest habitat, restoring riparian buffers and removing stream barriers for birds, brook trout and freshwater mussels.

geography.label: Central Appalachia (KY, MD, NY, OH, PA, VA, WV)

reporting: Applicants pick the metrics they will report on from a list in NFWF's Easygrants system.

status.quote: Central Appalachia Habitat Stewardship Program 2026 Request for Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date Thursday, July 16, 2026, 12:00 (noon) PM ET

geography.quote: includes portions of the Ohio River and Upper Tennessee River watersheds in Kentucky, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Virginia, and West Virginia

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through the National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

amount.quote: Grant requests must range from $75,000 to $500,000.

co_finance_required.quote: A non-federal match equal to or greater than the total funding request is preferred but not required.

reporting.quote: has a list of metrics in Easygrants for applicants to choose from for future reporting
